question: In December 2023, who became the first women Chief of Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Nina Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nina Singh** became the first woman Chief of the **Central Industrial Security Force (CISF)** in December 2023.
 
• The **CISF** is one of India's leading paramilitary forces tasked with providing security to critical infrastructure, including **airports, nuclear power plants, and government facilities.**
 
• **Nina Singh** is a senior officer from the **Indian Police Service (IPS)**, belonging to the Rajasthan cadre.
 
• Her appointment represents a significant milestone in **gender representation** in India's paramilitary forces, showcasing progress in **leadership roles for women**.
 
• The CISF was established in **1969** and operates under the aegis of the **Ministry of Home Affairs** in India.
 
• Nina Singh's extensive experience in **law enforcement and administrative roles** has contributed to her selection for this prestigious position.
 
• Her appointment aligns with India's broader goals of promoting **gender equality** in government institutions and public services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Archana Ramasundaram**__

 __
 
• **Archana Ramasundaram** was the first woman to head the **paramilitary force SSB (Sashastra Seema Bal).**
 
• She is a retired **IPS officer** from the Tamil Nadu cadre.
 
• Her appointment as the head of SSB marked a milestone in women's leadership roles in **Indian paramilitary forces.**
 
 
 
• **Vinita Mehra**__
 __
 
• **Vinita Mehra** is an experienced officer known for her contributions to **law enforcement and administrative reforms.**
 
• She has held significant positions in various government departments but has not been appointed as the Chief of CISF.
 
 
 
• **Rashmi Shukla**__
 
 
• **Rashmi Shukla** is a senior IPS officer who has been known for her work in **intelligence and crime prevention.**
 
• She has held various leadership roles but has not been appointed as the Chief of CISF.
